rows.definition: Session-owned bounded exact F32 rotary sin/cos device tables. One query slot or two compressed-publication slots reuse only matching values, model, epoch, backend, geometry and live session handles; replacement retains one transient upload.
rows.distinction: Caches uploaded rotary coefficients, not inverse-frequency host memoization, attention KV state or resident indexer-key history. Session closure detaches all rotary owners before fallible teardown and schedules each backend release attempt; physical retirement remains backend-owned.

rows.definition: Constructs the bounded rotary-table owner metadata for one or two fixed session keys, copying the key list and capturing the backend. It does not upload device tables; lookup and installation occur through the returned owner.
rows.distinction: Constructor operation rather than the retained rotary-table ownership state. v41RoPETableCache holds exact host values and live session tensor identity and participates in table replacement and session retirement.
